name: khala-network-chatgpt
description: Send and read Khala network mail from ChatGPT with owned, pull-only mailboxes.

interface.shortDescription: Send Khala mail and check your conversation mailbox.
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to an existing Khala network. Mail is fetched on request; no autonomous wake is required.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my Khala mailbox and check unread messages.
